goal: Prevent memory-amplification denial-of-service attacks from transactions with many small witness elements
Significantly reduce node memory usage for transactions kept in memory, especially under adversarial load
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile, with nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Strong support with code review and benchmarks confirming substantial memory savings
Code review approved after verifying reduced memory usage for small witness elements (optout21)
Verified by testing memory usage, finding mempool capacity increased with no average slowdown (instagibbs)
Suggested adding tests for compactsize boundaries and empty witness representation (instagibbs)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, xyzconstant, darosior, brunoerg)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it mitigates a memory-amplification denial-of-service vector for in-memory transactions
Adversarial worst-case size drops from 28 bytes per weight unit down to 1.6 bytes per weight unit
Enables the mempool to hold 13 to 15 percent more transactions under adversarial conditions
